Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
[panel] Add dual-level setup: project scaffolding + per-paper initialization

Follows the merit:setup pattern — panel:setup with no args does project-level
scaffolding, panel:setup <paper-name> [venue] initializes a single new paper
with directory structure, _panel.yaml, and RESEARCH.md update. Also adds
--check mode for setup validation.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
[panel] Add ship-it convention: commit, push, sync plugin + research

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
[panel] Fix sync scripts for MSYS/Git Bash on Windows

robocopy /flags get path-expanded by MSYS — use MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1.
robocopy exit codes 0-7 are success — use || RC=$?to prevent set -e
from killing the script on normal copy operations.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
[panel] Extend import with discovery + paper generation pipeline

Add 3 new discovery modes \(roadmap, waves, commits\) to panel:import alongside
existing artifact import. New shared modules topic-discovery.md and
paper-generator.md power the discover → propose → approve → generate pipeline.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
[panel] Rewrite sync scripts to match performance repo pattern

Scripts now pull target repo, copy files, commit with source hash, and
optionally push \(--push\). Also support --dry-run and --message flags.
Replaces robocopy-based approach with cp -r like performance scripts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

ablation study, statistical rigor, reproducibility details. Paper at ready stage.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
